Spacious 2-bed, 1-bath home ideal for a small family. Bright, freshly renovated throughout with modern finishes. Located in the highly sought-after Point Grey neighbourhood - quiet, family-friendly street. Steps to amenities, transit, and parks. A wall away from the #1 ranked public secondary school (Lord Byng) and top elementary schools - perfect for families prioritizing education.
